testo:
■ When you put this tamaseed, choose one of your opponent's creatures or tamaseeds and put it into its owner's hyperspatial zone.
■ When this tamaseed leaves, your opponent puts the creature or tamaseed that was put into their hyperspatial zone by the effect of this tamaseed from their hyperspatial zone.
